disambiguation: It performs comprehensive spelling and grammar reviews, not just simple text auto-correction.
extras: Sends note text to the configured endpoint when a check is run; requires external LanguageTool service.
intentEvidence: I made a custom plugin to port that tool over to obsidian!
motivation: The author wanted to port the Google Docs tool that scans the whole document and shows suggestions in one place to Obsidian.
problem: Manually correcting typos in Obsidian requires hovering over each typo and opening a suggestion menu individually.

relations.evidence: By default, the plugin uses the standard public LanguageTool API:

summary: A tool that reviews spelling and grammar issues in the current note using a Google Docs-style suggestion menu.
